# openmetadata_topic (Data Source)

Looks up a single OpenMetadata topic by id or fully qualified name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openmetadata_topic" "order_created" {
  fully_qualified_name = "events.order_created"
}

output "order_created_partitions" {
  value = data.openmetadata_topic.order_created.partitions
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `fully_qualified_name` (String) Topic fully qualified name. Exactly one of id or fully_qualified_name must be set.
- `id` (String) Topic UUID. Exactly one of id or fully_qualified_name must be set.

### Read-Only

- `cleanup_policies` (List of String) Cleanup policies, compact and/or delete.
- `description` (String) Markdown description.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name.
- `maximum_message_size` (Number) Maximum message size in bytes.
- `message_schema` (String) Message schema as a JSON object string with schemaType, schemaText and schemaFields keys.
- `minimum_in_sync_replicas` (Number) Minimum number of in-sync replicas.
- `name` (String) Topic name.
- `partitions` (Number) Number of partitions.
- `replication_factor` (Number) Replication factor.
- `retention_size` (Number) Retention size in bytes.
- `retention_time` (Number) Retention time in milliseconds.
- `service` (String) Fully qualified name of the parent messaging service.
- `topic_config` (String) Broker configuration as a JSON object string.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time in RFC 3339 format.
- `updated_by` (String) User that performed the last update.
- `version` (Number) Server-side entity version.
